labels.chronicle_first_snow: The first snow of the winter fell on the valley.
labels.chronicle_thunderstorm: A thunderstorm rolled over the valley.
labels.chronicle_drought: No rain had fallen for {days} days, and {count} crops stood still in the fields.
labels.chronicle_weather_year: The sky of year {year}, while the god meditated: thunderstorms {storms}, droughts {droughts}.
labels.miracle_calmed: The clouds part and the sky clears.
labels.miracle_sky_clear: Nothing falls from the sky to calm.
labels.function_help_alchemy_room: Alchemy room: an alchemy furnace and a medicine cabinet under a roof, with a door (tier 2, one crafter). The sect refines foundation pills and qi-gathering pills here, as well as the mixtures a herbalist brews.
labels.function_help_smithy: Smithy: an anvil and a hearth under a roof, with a door. Smiths forge ore and wood into tools, and work with tools in hand goes faster.
labels.unlock_spirit_herbs: grow spirit herbs where its qi lies deep
labels.chronicle_herbs_sprouted: Spirit herbs sprouted in the tree's deep qi.
labels.cause_tree_qi: the tree's qi had grown deep enough
labels.plan_refine_pills: fill the furnace with herbs and refine pills for the stores
labels.plan_forge_tools: bring ore and wood to the anvil and forge tools
labels.plan_take_a_pill_first: take pills from the stores for the trial, then face Heaven
labels.reason_refine: the stores lack medicine someone needs
labels.reason_no_smithy: there is ore and no smithy to work it
labels.reason_no_alchemy_room: spirit herbs grow and nobody can refine them
labels.cause_sect_needs_alchemy_room: spirit herbs grew and the sect had no alchemy room
labels.cause_no_tools: there was ore and nobody to forge it
labels.log_took_tools: Took a set of tools from the stores
labels.chronicle_pill_eaten: {name} swallowed a foundation pill as Heaven gathered.

labels.goal_seek_plans: set out to learn building plans
